findings.title: ADR-Proposer-001 embedded in proposer-spec.md has no frontmatter at all
findings.detail: ADR-Proposer-001 in docs/proposer-spec.md has no Status/Date/Author/Decider metadata fields, unlike ADR-001 through ADR-005 in ifleet-integration-adrs.md which all have proper frontmatter. Missing fields make the ADR undiscoverable and undatable in automated tooling.
findings.fix_sketch: Add Status, Date, Author, Decider, and Affects fields immediately after the ADR heading, matching the format used in ifleet-integration-adrs.md.
findings.fix_summary: Added Date: 2026-05-20, Author: T5, Decider: Sebastian Puig (pending review), Affects: M5 Proposer architecture fields to ADR-Proposer-001 section in docs/proposer-spec.md.

findings.title: Finding ID in 20260703T050000Z.json uses descriptive text not 8 hex chars
findings.detail: The finding 'AUDIT-audit-elevation-readme-stale-2026-07-03' in .audits/20260703T050000Z.json uses a descriptive text suffix instead of the 8-hex-char format required by plan.md schema (AUDIT-<repo>-<hash8>). This breaks fingerprint matching and ID format assumptions in tooling.
findings.fix_sketch: Compute sha256 of category|globs|title using rubric.json fingerprint_algo, use first 8 hex chars as ID suffix. Also add fingerprint field that was missing.
findings.fix_summary: Renamed 'readme-stale-2026-07-03' suffix to computed sha256[:8] = '740e2a40'. Added missing fingerprint field with full sha256 hex. ID format now conforms to schema.

findings.title: ADR-004 suggests 30-min reap TTL but lane-scheduler-spec.md implements 60-min prune
findings.detail: ADR-004 open questions section says 'scheduler reaps entries older than 30 minutes' but lane-scheduler-spec.md §2 lane-prune-stale.sh has STALE_AFTER_SEC default of 3600 (60 minutes). The summary table also says '30 min idle reap'. Two docs in conflict; the implementation spec (lane-scheduler-spec.md) is more authoritative.
findings.fix_sketch: Update ADR-004 open question and summary table to say 60 minutes, matching lane-scheduler-spec.md. No code change — doc alignment only.
findings.fix_summary: Updated ADR-004 open question from '30 minutes' to '60 minutes (matching STALE_AFTER_SEC=3600 default in lane-prune-stale.sh per lane-scheduler-spec.md §2)'. Summary table updated from '30 min idle reap' to '60 min idle reap'. Noted original-30-min vs implemented-60-min divergence for auditability.

findings.title: Phase 2 prerequisites table still marked BLOCKING from May 2026 — 7 weeks stale
findings.detail: plan.md Phase 2 prerequisites table header says 'BLOCKING' and statuses were recorded at 2026-05-20 design time. Phase 3 soak completed 2026-06-04 (39 days ago as of 2026-07-13). Prerequisites were never re-evaluated after soak. The stale table misleads implementers about actual Phase 2 readiness.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a warning note above the prerequisites table noting Phase 3 soak completed 2026-06-04 and that the statuses are 2026-05-20 baselines pending re-evaluation after Phase 4 gate decision. Update column header to note the baseline date.
findings.fix_summary: Added ⚠️ note above Phase 2 prerequisites table stating: 'Status as of 2026-07-13 (39 days since Phase 3 soak completed 2026-06-04): Prerequisites below were recorded at Phase 2 design time (2026-05-20) and were never formally re-evaluated after Phase 3 soak ended. Phase 4 gate decision is required before Phase 2 re-evaluation.' Changed column header from 'Status' to 'Status (2026-05-20 baseline)'.

findings.title: Self-healing deferrals reference '2-week soak' which completed ~2026-06-04 — decisions still pending
findings.detail: Multiple places in plan.md say 'defer to post-soak' or 'deferred until the 2-week soak proves...' without specifying that the soak completed 2026-06-04 and decisions are now overdue. Lines 22, 176-177, 214-216, 325-328 all affected.
findings.fix_sketch: Update all 'post-soak' and '2-week soak' references to include '(soak completed 2026-06-04; Phase 4 gate pending)' so readers understand the soak is done and decisions remain outstanding.
findings.fix_summary: Updated all 'post-soak' and '2-week soak' references in plan.md to include '(soak completed 2026-06-04; Phase 4 gate decision pending)' or similar specific date annotation. Affected: §Decisions confirmed with Seb, §Phase 2.5 Not in this plan, §Critical files Not touched, §Out of scope.

findings.title: ADR-001 through ADR-005 use 3-digit numbering; IFleet ADR convention uses 4-digit
findings.detail: Section headings in docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md use '## ADR-001', '## ADR-002', etc. IFleet's own ADR files use 4-digit numbering (0001-*, 0002-*, 0003-*). The summary table also uses 3-digit (001, 002...). Inconsistency makes cross-referencing by ID error-prone.
findings.fix_sketch: Rename section headings to ## ADR-0001 through ## ADR-0005 and update the summary table's ADR column from 001-005 to 0001-0005.
findings.fix_summary: Renamed all ## ADR-00N headings to ## ADR-000N and updated summary table ADR column from 3-digit to 4-digit format in docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md.
